question: Should OpenClaw adopt `CLAW.md` as the canonical export format for the experimental Claws package lifecycle once the open prerequisite stack is ready?
rationale: This is a new user-facing experimental package-format and export-contract choice, not a mechanical defect; the stacked parent PRs remain open and no maintainer decision in the provided discussion confirms the intended long-term format or upgrade posture.

options.title: Sponsor the CLAW.md format
options.body: Confirm `CLAW.md` as the experimental canonical export artifact, retain grouped JSON input, and require current-head lifecycle proof before merge.

options.title: Keep grouped JSON canonical
options.body: Retain the current grouped JSON export contract and close or narrow this branch until a later format decision is made.

options.title: Defer the format decision
options.body: Leave the PR open but pause merge review until the parent lifecycle stack is accepted and an owner records the intended package-format contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the CLAW.md format
recommendation.body: Confirm `CLAW.md` as the experimental canonical export artifact, retain grouped JSON input, and require current-head lifecycle proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored both the active stack and the preceding merged CLAW.md slice, so they are the clearest contributor-side routing contact; acceptance still requires a repository decision owner.
